- Provides systematic dream interpretation grounded exclusively in Freud’s four core texts, focusing on psychoanalytic theory.
- Explains dream meaning through mechanisms such as wish fulfillment, unconscious processing, condensation, displacement, and symbolism.
- Only interprets dreams with user description; relies on free association for personalized analysis and marks guesswork as symbolic reference.
- Refuses neuroscientific, prophetic, or moralizing interpretations; maintains strict Freudian boundaries.
- Includes detailed operating procedure, evaluative criteria, and covers both strengths and internal limitations of the Freudian framework.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of b2b-saas-pricing-coach, a coaching skill for B2B SaaS founders on structuring and optimizing pricing strategy.
- Helps founders choose and design value metrics (per-seat, per-API-call, per-asset, etc.) and tier structures.
- Guides decisions on headline pricing, free trial vs freemium vs paid, tier and add-on packaging, and discounting policies.
- Assists with repricing, grandfathering customers, enterprise tier design, and aligning pricing with sales motions (PLG vs sales-led).
- Provides a comprehensive diagnostic framework based on company stage, sales model, customer ICP, cost structure, and competitive landscape.
- Excludes consumer, e-commerce, agency, and open-source-only pricing topics.
